title: Core Quartet #33
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, four women in a single row.

A photograph of FOUR women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 4 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Lebanese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, cool and composed, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern — a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands, wide magenta-and-gold bands following every deep crease, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: both arms raised overhead.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme magenta-and-gold needle heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Pakistani woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, cheerful, elegant updo hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Islamic geometric star-tile pattern — a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star-and-polygon tile filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold thigh-high stiletto boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Egyptian woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, cool and composed, twin-tail hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, holographic finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic — a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, wide ochre bands following every deep crease, dense spiral floral bands filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera.

Right woman's footwear: extreme ochre extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Iranian woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, cheerful, curly hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, glossy finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework — a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease, dense geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: both arms raised overhead.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme gold-and-red platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 4, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
